source_text:
Title: Alderwick approves revised bus plan after public review
Published: 2025-06-18

Alderwick's Mobility Office proposed the Alderwick Frequent Bus Network Plan on 12 September 2024. The plan would add all-day service on three routes linking the city's central districts with the Eastbank employment area.

The office opened a public consultation on 3 February 2025, which ran through 14 March. After reviewing the responses, it published a revised network map on 10 June 2025.

Alderwick Council approved the revised plan on 17 June 2025. The service changes are scheduled for next year and have not yet started.
